excerpts: [section-template] ...sm, Mordent could be found at the [[Howling Oak]] in [[Darnassus]], where he served as a mage trainer, but only for the night elves.  ===Wolfheart=== {{Novel-section}} Despite seeking to make amends for the past and aid the kaldorei, Mordent had a difficult time as his Highborne mages were murdered in Darnassus. Mordent and his followers were called to a meeting with [[Maiev]], who was examining the murders. However, the Highborne fell prey to Maiev's trap, and they learned Maiev was actually the one responsible for the murders. One of Mordent's students, [[Var'dyn Skyseeker]], was killed in the trap. However, thanks to the efforts of [[Malfurion Stormrage]] and [[Jarod Shadowsong]], the Highborne were eventually freed, although Maiev managed to escape.<r...
